exposure: Physiotherapy program (preoperative training, educational training, postoperative exercises, connective tissue massage)
outcome: Functional activity (walking, turning in bed, transition to sitting)
Intestinal motility (passage of flatus, act of defecation)
cohort: The study involved 91 women admitted to an obstetric hospital for elective Cesarean section, divided into a control group (47 women) receiving standard care and an intervention group (44 patients) receiving standard care plus physiotherapy.
finding: The physiotherapy program significantly reduced postoperative pain, improved functional activity, accelerated recovery of intestinal motility, decreased the requirement for extra analgesics, and reduced the length of hospital stay in women after elective Cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study demonstrated the effectiveness of a physiotherapy program in improving recovery and reducing complications specifically in the early post-cesarean period.
